protocol: Four full-frame 64x64 grayscale thumbnails at 10%, 35%, 60% and 85% duration; compare clips with duration difference <=0.25 seconds; flag mean absolute pixel difference <3 and maximum frame mean difference <5 on the 0..255 scale.
identity_independence: Not established. This conservative content-similarity audit does not identify subjects or rule out different clips of the same person.
